history.R2_report_axis: index proximal-phalanx axis = (INDEX_PIP_R - INDEX_MCP_R), frozen Stage4B
history.R2_status_axis: index MCP->TIP chord = (INDEX_TIP_R - INDEX_MCP_R), frozen Stage4B

verdict: the R2 report's 0.000 mm is the offset along the index PROXIMAL-PHALANX axis; the R2 centre was searched INSIDE the plane normal to that axis, so 0.000 is a CONSTRUCTION statement about a different axis, not an independent measurement. The only real, reproducible measurement from the R2 blend is along the frozen approved-landmark MCP->TIP chord and equals -1.5157 mm; the R2 STATUS JSON value is therefore the correct one.

unique_authoritative_source.rule: INDEX_MCP axial authority = the component of (R2 INDEX_MCP - approved INDEX_MCP) along the unit vector from the approved INDEX_MCP to the approved INDEX_TIP.  Both endpoints are frozen Stage4B landmarks, so the rule is reproducible from the R2 blend alone and does not depend on the re-posed mesh.
